walkthroughs.body_html:
A tall structure has many layers and narrow spans of control; flat has few layers and wide spans.

Flat = faster decisions, more empowerment. Tall = clearer career path, tighter supervision.

High labour turnover is expensive — recruitment, training, lost productivity.

Reduce it via better pay, training, culture, recognition and career paths.

Labour turnover % = (leavers ÷ average staff) × 100.

If it's rising faster than the industry average, dig for causes: pay, management, workload, culture.
